Subject: The Cascade 45L is here — built for the trail, not the trophy shelf
CTA: Shop the Cascade 45L -> https://www.northbaysupply.com/products/NB-TRK-01
Body: You already know how a bad pack ruins a good trip. Straps that dig in by mile three. A frame that fights you on every switchback. Gear you can't reach without unpacking everything.

The Cascade 45L is designed around the opposite of that.

**What it carries:** 45 liters — enough for a 3-season overnight or a long day push with layers, food, and water.

**How much it weighs:** 1,400 grams (1.4 kg). That's base weight you'll actually feel over distance.

**What the shell is made of:** Ripstop nylon with a water-resistant finish. It handles light rain and trail splash without issue. It is not waterproof — if you're heading into sustained heavy rain, pack your sensitive gear in a liner or dry bags.

**Frame:** Internal frame that moves with your body and helps transfer load to your hips on longer carries.

The Cascade isn't built for technical mountaineering or multi-week expeditions. It's a trekking pack — versatile, honest, and easy to live out of on the trails where most of us actually spend our time.

No launch discount. No inflated original price. Just a pack priced for what it is.
